title: Pizza Connection 3 / Barro's Pizza image creation and handoff acceptance

truth_policy.rule: Generated image presence or visual appeal alone never proves game compatibility. PASS requires the named validation and retained evidence.
truth_policy.snapshot_rule: Runtime visual claims require screenshots from the actual running Workbench, Studio, or game.

gates.requirement: Workbench records source and candidate paths, SHA-256, dimensions, format, alpha requirement and intended PC3 target in one handoff manifest
PNG targets requiring alpha reject candidates that lose transparency
JPEG targets are flattened intentionally and preserve required dimensions without pretending to contain alpha
Studio reads the Workbench handoff manifest and validates actual candidate bytes against the expected contract
Agents can inspect the same image contract and cannot promote invalid or missing candidates to approved
A generated candidate can be traced source -> generation -> validation -> staging -> runtime screenshot -> restore/commit
Workbench integrated GUI exposes Creator status and image handoff state
Studio integrated GUI exposes Creator contract/evidence and image handoff validation state
